product.family: SLOTLIGHT LED III, recessed, 4 inch aperture, flush lens optic
product.description: continuous recessed light line in a ceiling slot: direct output 400 lm/ft (the lowest of its outputs), 3000 K, CRI 90, flush diffusing lens, run in lay-in lengths up to 150 ft
product.codeBasis: the family's catalogue prefix for the recessed 4 inch version with the flush lens optic; the full ordering string adds output, CCT, CRI, voltage and dimming

light.criBasis: published value (an 80 CRI version also exists)

electrical.control: dim to 1 %: 0-10 V, DALI or Lutron Hi-lume EcoSystem (LDE1)
electrical.supply: integral driver, universal 120-277 V or 347 V

housing.dimensionBasis: the 4 inch aperture converted to millimetres; the housing is 3.5 or 4 inches deep
housing.mounting: recessed, lay-in, in a continuous run up to 150 linear feet

photometricFile.note: Zumtobel's product pages link IES files by configuration; the files' addresses are built in the browser, so no direct URL is recorded.

sources.title: LightAZ, Zumtobel SL3 SLOTLIGHT LED III Recessed 4'' flush lens optic (outputs 400 lm/ft at 4 W/ft to 1000 lm/ft at 13 W/ft; 3000 K; CRI 90; aperture 4 in; housing 3.5 or 4 in deep; dimming; up to 150 ft)
Zumtobel Lighting Inc., SLOTLIGHT LED III Recessed / Opal Optic (400 to 1000 lm, 3000 K / 3500 K / 4000 K, CRI 90+)

unverified: The per-foot figures are LightAZ's transcription of the maker's specification; the maker's own spec sheet was not read. 400 lm/ft is 1312.3 lm/m and 4 W/ft is 13.1 W/m.

The earlier record named SLOTLIGHT infinity II (Europe), whose delivered flux per metre Zumtobel does not publish outside its article data sheets; this record is its North American sibling, whose output per foot is published.
The flush lens is taken as the diffusing cover of a recessed slot; its transmittance is inside the published direct output.
